observations: TargetCompletionReport.__post_init__ accepts obligations with isinstance(item, TargetObligation), not exact concrete type or reconstruction through the canonical TargetObligation constructor.
TargetCompletionReport.physical_credit becomes true when evaluated_fidelity is T4_PHYSICAL and report.status is COMPLETE.

A Python subtype can therefore override status while retaining UNKNOWN positive_readback and UNKNOWN counterevidence_probe fields that would make the canonical concrete TargetObligation status UNKNOWN.

counterexample.construction: Define class ForgedObligation(TargetObligation) overriding the status property to return ObligationStatus.PASS. Construct it with mandatory=true, required_fidelity=T4_PHYSICAL, positive_readback=UNKNOWN, no positive evidence refs, counterevidence_probe=UNKNOWN and no counterevidence refs. Pass it as the sole obligation to TargetCompletionReport at evaluated_fidelity=T4_PHYSICAL.
counterexample.current_source_prediction: The report accepts the subtype because isinstance is true, consumes the overridden PASS status, evaluates COMPLETE and returns physical_credit=true despite both required evidence channels remaining UNKNOWN.
counterexample.required_fail_closed_behavior: Reject non-exact TargetObligation instances at the consumer boundary, or reconstruct/revalidate every current obligation through a non-polymorphic canonical representation before status/physical-credit evaluation. UNKNOWN evidence must never be promotable through subtype dispatch.

why_it_matters: The workpackage exists specifically to prevent self-report or missing evidence from becoming completion evidence.
A polymorphic obligation can currently become a second completion authority and bypass the positive-readback plus counterevidence requirement.
At T4 the bypass reaches the physical_credit property, so the failure is not merely cosmetic report metadata.
required_regressions: A TargetObligation subclass overriding status must be rejected before report construction or evaluation.
A post-construction object.__setattr__ drift of authority-relevant TargetObligation fields must be revalidated at the report consumer boundary or otherwise made unable to affect report status.
Report physical_credit must derive only from exact currently validated concrete obligation state and independent evidence fields.
After repair, exact canonical TargetObligation UNKNOWN plus UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN at T4 and physical_credit must remain false.
